subject: Pro users can earn from communities — keep 70%
preview_text: Some owners now earn enough to cover their Pro multiple times over.
body_paragraphs: You've been Pro for a while now and your picks are consistent. Time to flip the model: open your own community on Predictify, set a small monthly price, and keep 70% of every subscription.
Top community owners are turning their picks into recurring income — and Predictify handles all the payment, hosting, and member management. You just keep predicting like you already do.
Setup is 90 seconds. Pick a name, pick a league, pick a price (or keep it free). Owners with a cover image grow 3x faster — we've made a generator that creates one for you in one tap.
